identity.title: OSHA Form 300A Summary of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses for Year 2025
agencies: U.S. Department of Labor - Occupational Safety and Health Administration

scan.summary: This is OSHA Form 300A, the annual summary of recordable work-related injuries and illnesses for calendar year 2025. The form is required to be completed by employers with 10 or more employees and must be posted in a visible workplace location from February 1 through April 30 of the following year. The form documents that Cascade Specialty Chemicals had 3 recordable cases in 2025 (1 case with days away from work, 2 other recordable cases), with 6 total days away from work and no fatalities.
scan.freshness_note: This form covers 2025 data and was issued February 1, 2026. As of September 29, 2026, the posting requirement has expired (ended April 30, 2026). The form must now be retained in records for five years from the end of calendar year 2025, through December 31, 2030.

expected_missing.basis: OSHA regulations require posting; companies should maintain evidence of when and where the form was displayed

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence in reading and interpreting this document. The form is straightforward and clearly labeled. The company meets OSHA's posting requirements (65 employees exceeds the 10-employee threshold). Key uncertainty: whether the company is required to submit data electronically to OSHA's Injury Tracking Application based on industry classification and size. The facility operates in manufacturing (NAICS 424690, a high-hazard industry), and with 65 employees falls in the 20-249 range; if this specific NAICS code is on the Appendix A list of covered industries, electronic submission by March 2, 2026 would have been required. This should be verified against OSHA's current Appendix A list. The document itself contains no gaps—it is a government form completed by the employer and is the official record. All factual entries read directly from the form.
